requirements.name: python3
requirements.description: Runs the plugin; standard library only, no pip packages

requirements.name: hyprctl
requirements.description: Hyprland only: sends the mute/deafen shortcut to the Discord window

requirements.name: Hyprland session
requirements.description: A running Hyprland instance, found in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hypr/

requirements.name: discord.com (HTTPS)
requirements.description: Network access to the Discord REST API, used by send-message

requirements.name: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/sdeck-plus/plugins/discord/token
requirements.description: Your bot token, owner-only (0600); never stored by the app

actions.name: Toggle mute (shortcut)
actions.description: Sends the mute shortcut to the Discord window on Hyprland. Delivery and the resulting state are not confirmed.

actions.name: Toggle deafen (shortcut)
actions.description: Sends the deafen shortcut to the Discord window on Hyprland. Delivery and the resulting state are not confirmed.

actions.name: Send bot message
actions.description: Posts a message to a channel as your Discord bot. The bot token is read from a file, never from the binding.
